limitations_admitted.value: O2 emission could be confined to a smaller area than the masks and hidden in the noise

referee_caveats_inferred: Abundance limits depend on a single disk mass (Calahan et al. 2021) and on an assumed 16O16O/16O18O of 280; gas-to-dust and mass uncertainties are not propagated
LTE over 9.4-300 K is broad; no physical temperature structure or non-LTE or disk-model treatment of where O2 would emit
Quoted limits are 1 sigma, not 3 sigma, which makes them weaker constraints than usual upper limits
Image-plane versus matched-filter sensitivity is not compared quantitatively, and the flux uncertainty method is not described
